questions.question: What is the primary goal of the Distance Vector Routing Algorithm?

answers.a: To find the shortest path between two nodes
answers.b: To determine the fastest network protocol
answers.c: To establish direct communication between all nodes

questions.question: Which type of information does each node maintain in Distance Vector Routing?

answers.b: Cost estimates to all other nodes
answers.c: A list of all network devices

questions.question: How do nodes exchange routing information in Distance Vector Routing?

answers.a: By broadcasting their full network topology
answers.b: By exchanging distance vectors with neighbors
answers.c: By sending data packets to all nodes
answers.d: By maintaining a central routing table

What happens when a node updates its distance vector?

answers.b: It immediately sends the updated vector to its neighbors
